svg.title: The three moves on permutation diagrams: (1) two successive crossings of the same pair of strands equal two straight strands, s_i squared equals e; (2) crossings of far-apart pairs of strands can slide past each other, s_i s_j = s_j s_i when |i-j| is at least 2; (3) three crossings among three strands can be rearranged, s_i s_{i+1} s_i = s_{i+1} s_i s_{i+1}.
